question: What is the main job of an operating system in a computer?

options.A: Managing computer hardware and software resources
options.D: Protecting the computer entirely from power surges

explanation: The operating system acts as the main controller that bridges physical hardware with user applications so the computer functions properly. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h1)

question: Why is an operating system often compared to a chief administrator?

options.A: It prevents users from ever installing unauthorized software
options.B: It physically repairs broken circuit boards inside the computer
options.C: It coordinates communication between hardware and application programs
options.D: It determines the financial cost of purchasing computer parts

explanation: Just like an administrator manages daily operations and staff requests, the operating system manages system resources and user program requests. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h1)

question: Which operating system part is responsible for communicating with hardware devices like printers?
explanation: Device drivers are specialized programs that allow the operating system to interact with hardware devices connected to the computer. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h2)

question: What happens during memory management by the operating system?

options.A: The system deletes old files to make room for new user documents
options.B: The system decides which programs get loaded into RAM and tracks memory use
options.C: The computer screen automatically adjusts its brightness levels
options.D: The computer permanently increases its hard drive storage capacity

explanation: Memory management tracks primary memory usage to ensure active programs have enough RAM to run without interfering with each other. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h2)

question: Which company developed the Windows operating system?
explanation: Microsoft Corporation is the developer and distributor of the Windows operating system family. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h3)

question: A clinic needs desktop computers that support various medical billing software. Which operating system is most practical?
explanation: Windows has the broadest compatibility with standard business software and hardware peripherals used in most office environments. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h3)

question: What does the term open-source mean for the Linux operating system?

options.A: The system only runs on computers manufactured by one company
options.B: The source code can be viewed, modified, and shared by anyone
options.C: The operating system code is completely hidden from the user
options.D: The software can only be operated with an expensive yearly license

explanation: Open-source software provides public access to its underlying source code so developers can study, change, and improve it freely. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h4)

question: Where is Linux most commonly used in modern computing infrastructure?

options.A: As the default firmware for basic pocket calculators
options.B: On enterprise web servers and cloud infrastructure
options.C: On home gaming consoles built by Microsoft
options.D: As the exclusive operating system on Apple iPhones

explanation: Due to its stability, security, and low cost, Linux is the leading operating system for servers, cloud platforms, and supercomputers. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h4)

question: Which technology company designs and distributes macOS?
explanation: Apple designs macOS specifically to run exclusively on its line of Macintosh personal computers. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h5)

question: Why does macOS generally experience fewer hardware driver conflicts than Windows?

options.A: The operating system is completely open-source and modified by the public
options.B: macOS does not use any drivers to communicate with computer hardware
options.C: Mac computers only connect to wireless printers and keyboards
options.D: Apple controls both the hardware manufacturing and the operating system design

explanation: Controlling both hardware and software allows Apple to tightly optimize macOS for specific components, reducing driver incompatibility issues. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h5)

question: Which factor is most important to look at first when choosing an operating system for work?

options.A: The physical weight of the computer keyboard and mouse
options.B: The aesthetic color of the computer desktop background wallpaper
options.C: The specific software applications required to complete job tasks
options.D: The number of video games pre-installed on the hard drive

explanation: Software compatibility is critical because specialized tools must be able to run properly on the chosen operating system platform. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h6)

question: A student wants a free, customizable operating system to learn programming. Which system fits best?
explanation: Linux is free, open-source, highly customizable, and serves as the standard platform for learning programming and server administration. [learn more](BMP123_U2_T1#BMP123_U2_T1_h6)
